statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
There is clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia
A mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous rhythm monitoring
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
The service is reasonable and necessary for diagnosis codes I47.1 and R00.2
